That it dug the word "flexbox" out of the actual page text, even though it's nowhere in the title, and then showed me the little highlighted sentence so I understand why it matched — that's genuinely useful. Searching across my titles, descriptions, notes, labels, and the saved page text is exactly the reach I wanted.

A few things I'd want to make sure this search can handle, since they're part of "finding things" for me:

- It shouldn't care about capital letters — searching "flexbox" or "Flexbox" should find the same thing.
- I'd like to be able to search by one of my labels directly, something like typing `#cooking`, and pull up everything with that label.
- When I remember an exact phrase, I'd want to put it in quotes and have it match just that phrase rather than the loose words.
- And ideally combine things a bit — like find pasta recipes that are tagged either cooking or weekend — so I can narrow down when I've got a lot saved.

Could you show me those kinds of searches work? The basic full-text match you've shown here is right; I just want to be sure the more precise searching is there too.
